sources.snippet: Write a handoff document summarising the current conversation so a fresh agent can continue the work. Save to the temporary directory of the user's OS - not the current workspace. Include a "suggested skills" section in the document, naming which skills the next agent should call the Skill tool for.

sources.title: ai-handoff · GitHub Topics · GitHub
sources.snippet: Contexta turns codebases into curated context packs for debugging, reviews, onboarding, refactors, and AI handoffs. It analyzes project structure, detects technologies, surfaces risks and hotspots, and exports structured Markdown through a cross-platform GUI + CLI.
